description: New statement in an existing SQL node: @Missing is not a parameter of the node (the base declares MinPrice). The SQL preflight checks the parameters of the base before the apply and refuses with op and line; before, only the Verify (InvalidSQL_UnknownParam) said it, after mutating.
expectError: op #0 (SQL IServerAction:Product_Search/SearchProducts, line 1): @Missing is used but the SQL node declares no parameter 'Missing' (declared: MinPrice)
